column1: # imports.tsv - one row per IAT slot (class iat, [0x4bc000,0x4bc404)); dll/name from the import descriptor (pefile)
# call_sites: method=capstone `call dword ptr [slot]` (FF15) sites in Ghidra function bodies
# load_sites: method=capstone any other operand equal to the slot (mov reg,[slot] / push [slot] / cmp [slot],.. / imm32)
# jmp_sites: `jmp dword ptr [slot]` thunks (FF25); thunk_caller_sites: direct `call thunk` sites (not counted in call_sites)
# functions: enclosing Ghidra functions of call+load+jmp sites (thunk callers listed separately); gap_sites: sites in .text outside every Ghidra function body (counted in call/load, not in functions)
# ghidra_refs: pass-4 imports_xrefs.csv iat_refs_from_code (Ghidra reference manager); ghidra_* columns carried verbatim
